credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}}, and operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}} despite higher depreciation charges.

Total debt was stable at {{total_debt@FY2025}} and net debt stable at {{net_debt@FY2025}}, so the higher EBITDA took net leverage down by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} and gross leverage down by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}.

Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}, and FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, lifting FFO to debt by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}.

Free cash flow rose by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}}, taking FCF to debt up by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, with capex intensity easing by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity fell by {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2025}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, a thinner buffer against the debt stock.
The TAV group's guarantee of part of the Antalya concession bank loan no longer exists at year-end after the refinancing of the previous loan.

peer_positioning.text: Groupe ADP has the weakest EBITDA margin of the airport group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} against a peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Leverage is the weakest in the group, with net leverage ranking {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}} against a peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}} and gross leverage ranking {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}} against a peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Cash generation also trails the group, with FFO to debt and FCF to debt both below the peer medians of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}} and {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, while capex intensity sits in the middle of the group.

snapshot.text: Groupe ADP, the Paris airport group that also consolidates TAV Airports, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}} in FY2025, with the renewed Ankara Esenboga concession entering service during the year.
Higher EBITDA brought net leverage down by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}}, while the EBITDA margin widened by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}.
The point to watch is cash liquidity, which fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} of revenue and sits below the peer median.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2025}}), with cash and cash-like investments down by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}.
Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} remains well above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}} despite the fall over the year.

Cash generation: FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} are both below the peer medians of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}} and {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, leaving limited headroom for the investment programme.
Contingencies: a dispute before Turkish courts over the withholding tax rate on dividends from a Turkish subsidiary remains a contingent liability.
